description: Mac screen to phone (screen_control_draft1). connection: the 16-byte contract nonce both sides derive from the session key and session ID. request and sourceStream: what the source (Mac) decodes; status, start and viewerStream: what the viewer (phone) decodes. Expected values are normalised: UUIDs lowercased, capabilities with every flag, absent optionals null, an unknown stop or control reason as failed. frame: display.frame plaintexts (the screen.frame layout) as the phone reads them. captureSize, letterbox, macPoint and keyboardEligible: the geometry rules (fractions compared to 1e-9). Edit protocol/tools/display_vectors.py, then run it.

request.name: unknown fields and capabilities are ignored
a flag that is not a boolean

viewerStream.name: control from a viewer is not read by the viewer
stop, stream ID not a UUID

sourceStream.name: ack asking for a key frame
control from a source is not read by the source

frame.name: a key frame in one part
a middle part needs no start code

letterbox.name: portrait phone, top edge of the picture
portrait phone, on the top letterbox
portrait phone, on the bottom letterbox
landscape phone, on the left pillarbox

macPoint.name: external display to the left (negative origin)

keyboardEligible.name: two displays, window on the shared one
two displays, window on the other one
two displays, window across, centre on the shared one
